headline: RBI governor reiterates mandatory stock exchange listing for upper-layer NBFCs
summary: Reserve Bank of India Governor Sanjay Malhotra reaffirmed that upper-layer non-banking financial companies must list on stock exchanges, maintaining pressure on Tata Sons.
why: Regulatory mandates requiring public listings of major financial institutions increase transparency and corporate governance standards for massive holding companies.

impacts.name: Tata Sons
impacts.why: Enforced public listing requirements compel private conglomerates to open their capital structure to public shareholders.
